paper.title_en: Strange-metal behavior in correlated molecular conductors
paper.abstract_en: The $κ$-BEDT-TTF salts are prototypical Mott systems, realizing a correlation-driven electronic transition from a Fermi-liquid state to a Mott insulator. The metallic compounds with spatially modulated Hg-containing anions, $κ$-(BEDT-TTF)$_4$Hg$_{3-δ}X_8$ ($X$ = Br, and Cl), however, fall outside this classification. Our temperature-dependent transport and broad-range optical investigations reveal a $ρ(T)\propto T$ dependence of the resistivity up to elevated temperatures and a power-law behavior of the frequency-dependent conductivity $\vert\hatσ (ω)\vert \propto ω^{-0.7}$; well-known hallmarks of ``strange metals''. The linear-in-frequency scattering rate of these strange metals scales to the Planckian dissipation. We demonstrate that this response only occurs in systems with incommensurate anion layers and establish a direct link to large-scale spatial modulations. Our conclusions can be extended to other strongly correlated strange-metal compounds

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文报告了κ-(BEDT-TTF)₄Hg₃₋δX₈盐中线性电阻率与幂律光学电导率，并关联到Planckian耗散，属于强关联凝聚态系统中与全息方法密切相关的奇异金属研究，具有较高的方法严谨性、理论相关性及可读性。
decision.title_zh: 关联分子导体中的奇异金属行为
decision.abstract_zh: $\kappa$-BEDT-TTF盐是典型的Mott系统，实现了从费米液体态到Mott绝缘体的由关联驱动的电子转变。然而，具有空间调制含Hg阴离子的金属化合物$\kappa$-(BEDT-TTF)$_4$Hg$_{3-δ}X_8$（$X$ = Br和Cl）却不在这一分类之内。我们的温度依赖输运和宽范围光学研究揭示了电阻率$\rho(T)\propto T$一直持续到较高温度，以及频率依赖电导率的幂律行为$\vert\hatσ (ω)\vert \propto ω^{-0.7}$；这些都是“奇异金属”的已知标志。这些奇异金属的频率线性散射率标度到Planckian耗散。我们证明这种响应只发生在具有非公度阴离子层的系统中，并建立了与大尺度空间调制的直接联系。我们的结论可以推广到其他强关联奇异金属化合物。
